name: Flattened Gaussian Ellipsoid Rendering
definition: A technique to approximate 2D Gaussian ellipses (surface-like representations) by flattening the 3D Gaussian ellipsoids.
summary: Flattened Gaussian Ellipsoid Rendering approximates 2D Gaussian ellipses by flattening 3D ellipsoids to enable stable surface-like rendering within a differentiable volume rendering framework.
